title: Geometric reducedness over a perfect field
statement:
Let $X$ be a reduced scheme of finite type over a perfect field
$K$, where perfect means that $K$ has characteristic $0$, or has
characteristic $p>0$ and the map $a\mapsto a^p$ is surjective on $K$.
For every field extension $L/K$, the scheme $X_L$ is
reduced. Consequently $X\to\Spec(K)$ is flat and of finite
presentation and has geometrically reduced fibres.

proof.text: Apply the existing library theorem AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyReduced.of_perfectField to the structure morphism f. Its complete proof pulls an affine cover of X back along each field extension L/K, writes each chart morphism as Spec of a ring homomorphism, identifies the chart pullback with Spec(A tensor_K L) using pullbackSpecIso, and proves it reduced by isReduced_tensorProduct_of_perfectField and affine_isReduced_iff. IsReduced.of_openCover gives reducedness globally; geometrically_iff_of_commRing_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms packages this as GeometricallyReduced f. No finite cover or residue-field identification is required.

source.place: GeometricallyReduced.of_perfectField and isReduced_pullback_spec_map_of_perfectField, lines 98-123; implements the affine reduction and Stacks 00I4 argument of the blueprint

proof.text: Spec K is locally Noetherian because a field is Noetherian. Apply LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian to obtain IsLocallyNoetherian X. The Mathlib instance in Noetherian.lean obtains LocallyOfFinitePresentation f by applying Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType to each affine section map over a Noetherian ring.

source.place: LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and the following LocallyOfFinitePresentation instance; Stacks 01T6 and 00FP

proof.text: Every morphism to Spec K is flat by the Mathlib Flat instance for a subsingleton integral target. IsLocallyNoetherian.quasiSeparatedSpace makes X quasi-separated, and QuasiSeparated.of_quasiSeparatedSpace gives QuasiSeparated f. QuasiCompact f is the given instance. These are all the finite-presentation and flatness clauses.

source.place: IsLocallyNoetherian.quasiSeparatedSpace (Stacks 01OY), with Morphisms/QuasiSeparated.lean: QuasiSeparated.of_quasiSeparatedSpace and Morphisms/Flat.lean: subsingleton integral target instance

proof.text: For every field extension L/K, apply pullback_of_geometrically to GeometricallyReduced.geometrically_isReduced from the first step and the canonical Spec L -> Spec K map. This gives IsReduced of the exact pullback in the statement. Assemble this result and the five morphism-property instances into the required conjunction.

source.place: pullback_of_geometrically; the concluding conjunction of the blueprint statement
